'''Dancer Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] that used [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class fighters]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] the squadron was under the command of [[Syal Antilles]] and stationed on ''[[Blue Diver]]'' as part of the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]]. During a battle precipitated by a false negotiations offer from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] the [[Centerpoint Station]] superweapon was fired at the Alliance fleet, and Dancer Squadron was caught in the attack. Antilles and her gunner [[Zueb Zan]] were the only survivors from the squadron.
